Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelis Coren: 31-year-old woman, 167 cm (medium), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: square compact face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, long-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: an extensive but nonmagical geometric tattoo language across both arms. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
